$description: The Source Scout's watchlist. One record per endpoint the Scout polls. This is agent configuration, NOT a dataset: nothing here is a source record, nothing here is cited by the site, and no entry may be copied into data/sources.json without a human reading the document it returned.
$note: Every entry ships with url_status 'url:unchecked' and stays that way in this file. The Scout does not rewrite the registry from a run: a live endpoint today is not a fact about the endpoint tomorrow, and a config file that edits itself is a second home for a fact the report already carries. Which entries actually resolved is recorded per run in agent/scout/reports/, and an entry that has never resolved appears under 'unresolved retrieval problems' in every summary until a human fixes or removes it. The url_status vocabulary is data/taxonomy.json's, used with the same meaning.
$boundaries: The Scout is read-only against the network and read-only against data/*.json. tier and expected_type are the operator's prior expectation about a publisher, recorded so the report can say when a retrieval did not match it. They are NOT an assertion about any individual document, and the Scout never writes them into a source record.
